verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly claims billing only for compute time, not wall time, even during hibernating WebSockets or long agent workflows, aligning with the story's ask. However, this is vendor-stated pricing docs only, and community evidence notes CPU-time limits (30s free/15min paid) causing friction for long-running agent workloads, suggesting real-world caveats to the 'pay for active compute only' promise.
